name: IC Interface USB — 3.3V, 5V, USB — QFN
description: USB interface IC cluster supporting 3.3V and 5V operation in surface-mount QFN packaging including the CH343P.
selection_hints: A surface-mount USB interface IC compatible with 3.3V or 5V is needed.
Design uses QFN packaging such as the WCH_QFN-16-1EP_3x3mm_P0.5mm_EP1.8x1.8mm footprint.
Using quality tier B components from the KiCad symbols library.
avoid_when: Package requirements call for non-QFN or through-hole footprints.
Target system voltages are outside 3.3V and 5V.
An interface protocol other than USB is required.
